remarks: Stunning Renovated 2-Bedroom Apartment in South Norwalk's coveted Golden Hill District. Completely renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom first-floor apartment with 9-foot ceilings and a private entrance, located in the heart of South Norwalk. This home seamlessly combines modern luxury with timeless Victorian charm, boasting brand-new features throughout, including refinished hardwood floors, granite countertops, all-new stainless steel kitchen appliances, a fully renovated bathroom, and a new washer and dryer. Enjoy outdoor living on two beautifully maintained covered porches and a landscaped yard. Just a short walk to South Norwalk's vibrant restaurants, shops, train station, and beaches, this apartment also includes designated parking for added convenience. Don't miss this exquisite home-it won't last long! The owner resides on the property and prefers tenants with a minimum credit score of 700.
